Name: PurpleDew Valley Animals
Author: EnbyFelix
Description: Alternative Textures pack to make most animals purple. Some animals are aqua, one is orange, and one is a [i]secret [/i]color. All animals are added, including the 1.5 new animals. Also only the default dog and default cat are changed. The animal products are not changed, I will be making another mod for my PurpleDew Valley series that will do that. You will need to purchase the scissors at Robin's and use it on the animal to change its color. Have fun with your purple animals!

Downloads.Description: AT pack to change all animals, most change to purple. Does not change animal products.
